headline: Magnitude 7.2 earthquake strikes off coast of Sendai, triggering tsunami advisory
body: A powerful 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck off the northeastern coast of Japan near Sendai on Monday morning. The Japan Meteorological Agency issued a tsunami advisory for coastal areas, warning of waves up to one meter. Bullet train operations were temporarily suspended as engineers inspected track integrity.

headline: Tsunami advisory lifted after 7.2 tremor rocks northeastern Japan
body: Authorities in Japan have canceled all tsunami advisories hours after a magnitude 7.2 offshore earthquake shook Miyagi and Fukushima prefectures. Minor coastal swells were recorded in Sendai harbor. Emergency officials reported minor structural damage and several injuries, but no fatalities.

headline: Sendai earthquake: Recovery teams inspect rail networks and nuclear facilities
body: Search and safety teams across northeastern Japan are conducting safety checks at nuclear power plants and high-speed rail lines following Monday's offshore tremor near Sendai. Power utility regulators confirmed no radiation anomalies were detected at Onagawa or Fukushima Daini plants.

headline: Bullet train services resume normal schedule after Sendai offshore temblor
body: East Japan Railway resumed regular Shinkansen bullet train operations on Tuesday following comprehensive track and overhead wire safety inspections prompted by the 7.2 magnitude earthquake off Sendai. Industrial supply chains in the Tohoku region reported minimal disruption.

headline: James Webb Space Telescope detects massive galaxy cluster from dawn of the universe
body: Astronomers utilizing the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have identified a gravitationally bound proto-galaxy cluster originating merely 400 million years after the Big Bang. The discovery challenges established cosmological models concerning the rate of early cosmic structure formation.

headline: Webb telescope reveals surprisingly mature galaxies in the infant cosmos
body: Data captured by the James Webb Space Telescope's NIRCam spectrograph demonstrates that primordial galaxies in an ultra-distant cluster possessed substantial stellar mass much earlier than standard cosmological theory predicted. Lead researchers at Cambridge and Caltech announced the peer-reviewed findings.

headline: Astrophysicists debate cosmic timelines after JWST spots unexpected galaxy cluster
body: The discovery of a dense cluster of ancient galaxies by the James Webb observatory has ignited debate among theoretical astrophysicists. Spectral analysis indicates rapid star formation rates, suggesting early dark matter halos accumulated gas more efficiently than previously simulated.

headline: European Central Bank raises key interest rate by 25 basis points to counter sticky inflation
body: The European Central Bank raised its benchmark deposit facility rate by 25 basis points to 4.00% on Thursday. ECB President Christine Lagarde emphasized that underlying inflationary pressures across the eurozone remain persistent despite softening energy costs.

headline: Lagarde signals ECB borrowing costs may stay elevated as eurozone inflation lingers
body: Christine Lagarde delivered a resolute message following the ECB's decision to hike key interest rates to 4.00%, stating that monetary policy will remain restrictive for as long as necessary. European bond yields edged higher following the governing council announcement in Frankfurt.

headline: Euro edges higher against US dollar after ECB tightens monetary policy
body: The euro strengthened modestly against the dollar after the European Central Bank increased interest rates by a quarter percentage point in Frankfurt. Currency analysts attributed the move to Christine Lagarde's hawkish forward guidance and commitment to the 2% price stability target.

headline: Global Climate Summit in Dubai adopts treaty to triple renewable capacity by 2030
body: Diplomats from nearly 200 nations concluded the Global Climate Summit in Dubai on Saturday with an accord pledging to triple global renewable energy generation capacity and double energy efficiency improvements by the end of this decade.

headline: Delegates approve landmark clean energy roadmap as Dubai climate conference ends
body: The United Nations climate negotiations in Dubai drew to a close with delegates cheering the unanimous adoption of a roadmap targeting clean energy transition and substantial financing commitments for developing countries vulnerable to climate disruption.

headline: Metropolitan Museum inaugurates retrospective exhibition of Venetian Renaissance glasswork
body: The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York opened a rare retrospective exhibition on Thursday showcasing over one hundred surviving pieces of 16th-century Murano glass, featuring blown cristallo goblets and enameled decorative chalices from Italian workshops.

headline: Marine biologists discover bioluminescent lanternfish variant in Kermadec Trench
body: An oceanographic expedition near New Zealand's Kermadec Trench has documented an unclassified species of bioluminescent lanternfish surviving at depths exceeding six thousand meters, offering new biological insights into deep-sea pressure adaptation.
